quirks: Bot wall: smythstoys.com sits behind Imperva/Incapsula. A fresh headless/automated browser gets an 'Additional security check is required - Click to verify' interstitial before any page loads; a non-JS fetch gets 'Pardon Our Interruption'. An agent benchmark should expect this.
Physical GTA VI at Smyths is a download code in a box, not a disc; the box ships/collects from Nov 12 (pre-load) and the game is playable from Nov 19.

No money is taken for card pre-orders at checkout: card is pre-authorised 2-7 days before availability and charged on dispatch/collection; if pre-auth fails you get 24 hours to re-enter card details or lose the order.
PayPal pre-orders are charged in full immediately (different from cards).
Pre-order Price Promise: lower price on dispatch/collection day is honoured automatically, but not combined with a money-off voucher.
Click & Collect is free with a 2-day hold and a £2 non-collection fee; collector must show photo ID of the person who placed the order plus the 'Ready for Collection' email.
Delivery thresholds pivot on £20: standard delivery is free over £20, so a single £67.99 game qualifies; express is £1.99 next working day.

Orders cannot be amended or cancelled once placed (per Smyths help), but pre-orders can be cancelled / have payment details updated from a Smyths Toys account; guests are told to create an account to do this.
Site is region-switched between UK (/uk/en-gb) and Ireland (/ie/en-ie); Trustpilot reviews mention the region flipping at checkout and vouchers failing as a result.
PS5 listing warns the code only works on a PlayStation account registered to the United Kingdom.
Only Standard edition exists at Smyths (no physical Ultimate edition exists; Ultimate is digital-only at £89.99).
